newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end flat, all eyes on FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end flat, all eyes on FOMC.

text.p: 1425 GMT - Austrian shares close steady on Tuesday after sluggish trading session as investors keep to sidelines ahead of key FOMC meeting later in the day, traders said.
"We did nothing but wait around today," said one.
* ATX index down 0.02 percent at 1,215.48 points.
* 12 ATX shares lower, eight higher, one unchanged.
* April ATX future up 3.5 points at 1,217.5 on turnover of 610 contracts.
* Top gainer Radex, up 3.05 percent at 439 schillings ahead of 1996 results due out on Wednesday.
* Leading decliner AMS, down 3.25 percent at 1,071. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
